description: Change the settings of existing adjustment layers (the Properties panel). Only the options given change; the rest keep their values. Also sets name, opacity, blend mode and clipping. Options by type: brightness_contrast (brightness, contrast, useLegacy); levels (channel, inputBlack, inputWhite, gamma, outputBlack, outputWhite, auto); curves (channel, points); exposure (exposure, offset, gamma); vibrance (vibrance, saturation); color_and_vibrance (temperature, tint, vibrance, saturation); hue_saturation (hue, saturation, lightness, colorize, ranges); color_balance (shadows, midtones, highlights, preserveLuminosity); black_and_white (reds, yellows, greens, cyans, blues, magentas, tint, tintColor); photo_filter (filter, color, density, preserveLuminosity); channel_mixer (monochrome, red, green, blue, gray); selective_color (method, reds, yellows, greens, cyans, blues, magentas, whites, neutrals, blacks); gradient_map (gradient, reverse, dither, method); posterize (levels); threshold (level); clarity_and_dehaze (clarity, dehaze); grain (amount, size, roughness).

clip.description: Use Previous Layer to Create Clipping Mask: affect only the layer below

options.description: Settings for the chosen type; see the list in this tool's description. Omitted settings use Photoshop's defaults

target.description: Adjustment layers of the given type

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)
